snippet.title: 3D肝試し (3D Kimodameshi) | Japanese Horror Game on Mobile | Full HD 1080p 60ᶠᵖˢ
snippet.description:
Japanese Horror Game 3D肝試し Full Playthrough Walkthrough. 

About 3D肝試し(3D Kimodameshi):
"Experience a 3D realistic game with a Japanese-style horror atmosphere. There is no tapping involved for game play. Trigger events by moving around an abandoned house and viewing things in the first person in 360°. If you get stuck you can view hints by tapping the hint icon (the eye) in the top right corner of the screen (The hint icon will only appear in specific areas of the game)". 

A horrifying experience, and a taste of classic J-Horror on your mobile device. Pay attention to your surroundings, because someone is trying to tell you something. Something that...you may not like. 

Technical Details:

➥Genre: Psychological Horror
➥Developer: SIRIUS

➥Platforms: Android
